summary: A built-in image-edit call recorded the training source in generation provenance but implicitly consumed the most recent conversation image and returned the sealed garden-workbench source instead. The candidate was correctly rejected visually, but the workflow lacked an explicit tool-level source binding and a generation-failure graph branch.

items.requirement: Every candidate, validation, and test image-edit call must pass exactly one resolved local source through referenced_image_paths, must omit num_last_images_to_include, and must never use implicit recent-image context.
items.required_probe: Inspect provider_parameters.source_binding and visually compare every output with its exact source before judging.

items.requirement: An unrelated-source output or terminal generation batch failure must route directly from generation to review and output, without judge, refinement, validation, or test execution.
items.required_probe: Run mock-scenario-source-binding-failure.json and require the seven-step failure path with no judge or refinement node.
